svg.text: An integrated, interoperable health information ecosystem built on the OpenHIE architecture,
connecting all health systems via FHIR-based interfaces through a unified Master Patient Index.
Routing · FHIR Mediation · Audit Logging · Legacy Adapters · Security (mTLS + OAuth 2.0)
All inter-system data flows mediated — zero point-to-point connections
RDIP Infrastructure · G-Cloud Sovereign Hosting · Government Service Bus · National Digital Identity · ProgressaPay · IFMIS · Data Protection Legislation
